about: What someone who knows another language writes by reflex, and the Nuclear form (the base brief's table).

rows.title: Not `a.contains(x)` / `a.includes(x)` — in Nuclear: `x in a`
rows.summary: In Nuclear write `x in a` instead of `a.contains(x)` / `a.includes(x)`. Also `key in map`.
body: Someone who knows TypeScript, Dart or Python writes `a.contains(x)` / `a.includes(x)`.
In Nuclear: `x in a`. Also `key in map`.
When the compiler sees the habit it reports `N0022` with the Nuclear form, and `nuclear fix` applies the exact ones.

rows.title: Not `&&` `||` `!x` `===` — in Nuclear: `and` `or` `not x` `==`
rows.summary: In Nuclear write `and` `or` `not x` `==` instead of `&&` `||` `!x` `===`. Comparisons are always strict.
body: Someone who knows TypeScript, Dart or Python writes `&&` `||` `!x` `===`.
In Nuclear: `and` `or` `not x` `==`. Comparisons are always strict.
When the compiler sees the habit it reports `N0022` with the Nuclear form, and `nuclear fix` applies the exact ones.

rows.title: Not `await load()`, `async` — in Nuclear: `~load()`
rows.summary: In Nuclear write `~load()` instead of `await load()`, `async`. Afunction that uses `~` is async by itself.
body: Someone who knows TypeScript, Dart or Python writes `await load()`, `async`.
In Nuclear: `~load()`. A function that uses `~` is async by itself.

rows.title: Not `{ ... }` blocks, `;` — in Nuclear: a 2-space indented block, no `;`

body: Someone who knows TypeScript, Dart or Python writes `{ ... }` blocks, `;`.
